title: What's New: Payables Agent Update (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction and Overview of Payables Agent
Customer Feedback and AI Development Philosophy

features.name: AI-powered invoice processing
features.description: The payables agent provides end-to-end AI-powered invoice processing that covers the entire vendor invoice workflow. It interprets invoices and presents reasoning to users about how invoices are registered.
features.status_evidence_quote: right now the payables agent is in preview
caveats: Currently in preview in four countries: United States, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand
AI-generated content requires human review as there can be errors

features.name: Email-based invoice ingestion
features.description: The agent monitors a configured email address for incoming PDF invoice attachments. It automatically processes any new emails without requiring active monitoring in Outlook or other email clients.
caveats: Organizations can choose whether to expose the email address to vendors or use it only for internal forwarding

features.name: Draft invoice review with reasoning
features.description: After processing an invoice, the agent provides a draft with suggested line items, deferrals, and other details. The interface shows the AI-generated content for human review with transparency about the agent's reasoning.
caveats: All content is AI-generated and requires human review
A human must confirm before the agent creates a final purchase invoice

features.name: Vendor creation with blocking
features.description: When the agent encounters an unrecognized vendor, it can suggest creating a new vendor record. New vendors are automatically set with the blocked field to 'all' to ensure due diligence and approval processes are followed before the invoice can be processed.
caveats: New vendors are blocked and must be unblocked by the user before invoice processing can continue
Respects existing vendor approval and due diligence processes

features.name: Minimal setup required
features.description: The agent is designed as a turnkey solution with minimal configuration needed. Out of the box it works with Business Central systems, but optional parameters can be tweaked for different processing workflows and matching algorithms.
caveats: No mapping of items or accounts to existing data required

features.name: Vendor matching improvements
features.description: Future enhancement to improve the agent's ability to recognize and match vendors. The agent will get better at identifying existing vendors when processing invoices.
caveats: Part of upcoming wave functional expansion

features.name: Purchase order matching
features.description: The agent will handle two-way and three-way matching with purchase orders in the system, covering both product purchases and services or accounts. This enables matching of invoices against existing purchase orders.
caveats: Will support both two-way and three-way matching

features.name: E-invoice support
features.description: The agent will be able to process electronic invoices such as e-invoices common in Europe, in addition to PDF invoices. It will handle invoicing from multiple sources.

features.name: Fraud detection
features.description: The agent will have capabilities to identify fraudulent invoices and handle anti-fraud scenarios to help protect against invoice fraud.

features.name: Approval automation
features.description: Future capability for the agent to handle approval workflows. Users will be able to approve invoices from anywhere, potentially enabling more autonomous approval processes.
caveats: Approval location flexibility is the goal

features.name: Autonomous invoice posting
features.description: Future capability where the agent could automatically post invoices after approval, reducing manual steps in the invoice processing workflow.
caveats: User decision on whether to enable

features.name: Payment suggestions
features.description: The agent may be able to create optimal payment suggestions as part of its long-term vision for end-to-end invoice and payment processing.

features.name: General availability rollout
features.description: The agent will be made available to as many customers as possible with worldwide availability, though there may be language and geographical restrictions.
caveats: May have language and geographical restrictions

features.name: Continuous learning from usage
features.description: The agent improves over time as it processes more invoices and learns how the customer does business. It learns from historical invoices and actual usage patterns.
